benchmarks.commonRules: All benchmark inputs as known at the state evaluation time (latest completed close = previous session close; FRED vintages with realtime_start before the state date). Same states, same outcomes, same inference. Thresholds below are fixed now from conventional levels, not fitted.
benchmarks.faultlineAlarm: PI >= 45 (ELEVATED band, frozen engine threshold; scoreToLevel engine.ts:143-149)

list.name: Unconditional market history
list.notes: Defines the baseline for economic margins and Brier/rank skill = 0.
list.score: constant (no information); outcome distribution over the same states

list.name: Simple credit-spread regime
list.notes: HY OAS is also an engine input, so this is the most direct test of whether the composite adds anything.
list.score: HY OAS bps where available (C1, C2); BAA10Y in proxy windows

list.name: Sahm rule
list.score: real-time Sahm value from UNRATE vintages

list.name: Equal-weight z-score composite of FAULTLINE raw inputs
list.notes: Minimum 126 prior observations per input, otherwise UNAVAILABLE for that state. Tests whether FAULTLINE weights/maps add value over naive aggregation.
list.score: mean of expanding-window z-scores of HY, SOFR, DGS10, -(DGS10-DGS2), CPI YoY, PPI YoY, FEDFUNDS, UNRATE (stress-oriented)

list.name: Randomized classification null
list.notes: 10,000 draws, seed 20261004; p-value = share of null statistics >= observed.
list.score: FAULTLINE regime labels re-assigned with identical class frequencies: (a) random circular shift of the label series relative to outcomes, (b) stationary block shuffle (mean block = 2h, min 21)

blindness: No historical FAULTLINE score, reconstruction, metric file or HMM validation artifact was opened before freezing. Disclosed incidental exposure: live forward-ledger PI values 28-33 (MODERATE RISK) for 2026-09-14..2026-10-01 seen in /workspace/validation-foundation/probe/probe-out2.txt while checking the formulaHash prefix.

engineBinding.rule: This test id binds to this engine SHA and this methodology hash; any change to scoring code, thresholds, weights, inputs, horizons, outcomes, benchmarks or verdict rules requires a new test id.

exclusionRules.evaluationDatasetAdmits: only designated scheduled states (C1 harness states; C2 QLS states)
excludedButPreserved: v1 outcome rows (intraday target, base before/at state, day-keyed)
V3-H shadow engine rows (separate experimental engine)
exclusionRules.preservation: Rows are never deleted or modified; exclusions.json lists ids, timestamps, provenance and reason; later exclusions are appended in a new versioned file, never overwriting this one.

hypotheses.test: Spearman rho(PI, MDD_21) < 0 (primary) and rho(PI, RV_21) > 0 (secondary); one-sided
hypotheses.text: Higher PI precedes deeper forward drawdowns and higher realized vol.

hypotheses.test: Jonckheere-Terpstra trend test of MDD_21 across occupied bands LOW<MODERATE<ELEVATED<HIGH<CRISIS; bands with <60 states merged toward MODERATE; untestable if <2 bands remain
hypotheses.text: Regime bands are ordered: higher bands precede worse outcomes.

hypotheses.test: OLS MDD_21 ~ PI_z + UpTrans5 + ret_21 + ret_63 + RV_trailing_21; HAC Wald test on {PI_z, UpTrans5}; beta_PI < 0 required
hypotheses.text: PI level and upward regime transitions add information beyond trailing return/vol.

hypotheses.test: For each ruleB onset10 event: flagged if any state in [onset-63, trough] has PI >= 45; lead = onset - first flag (sessions); recall, precision (flag followed by onset within 63 sessions), false-alarm rate. Descriptive if <5 events.
hypotheses.text: Stress is flagged before or during deterioration.

inference.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap CIs for every reported statistic
inference.dependence: overlapping horizons: stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano), mean block length max(2h,21) sessions, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261004; regressions use Newey-West HAC with lag = ceil(1.5h)
inference.multipleTesting: Holm-Bonferroni across PM1-PM4 within each set, family alpha 0.05 one-sided; secondary/exploratory reported unadjusted and labelled
inference.sampleSize: report N states, N matured outcomes per horizon, N_eff = N/h (and Bartlett-adjusted), events count; any metric with N_eff < 30 is reported but cannot support PASS or FAIL

primary.metric: Jonckheere-Terpstra z for MDD_21 across bands
HAC Wald p-value and incremental R^2 of {PI_z, UpTrans5}
delta-rho = rho_FAULTLINE - rho_benchmark on MDD_21 vs (a) B11 equal-weight composite and (b) best single benchmark among B02-B10 (best chosen on the same data, which penalizes FAULTLINE)

secondary: rho and JT on RV_21, R_21, MDD_63, RV_63
E_h frequency by band with Wilson CIs

completedBarRule.base: the first completed close NOT known at the state evaluation time (i.e. first bar with completedAt >= evalTime); for a normal 18:00 UTC state this is the same-day close
completedBarRule.completedAt: scheduled close + 60 min (adopted from PR #61 v2 design; PR #61 is OPEN and not part of 1cfa129, so the rule is enforced by the evaluation harness, not by prod code)
completedBarRule.knownAtState: a bar is usable as an input iff completedAt < state evaluation time
completedBarRule.sessionClose: scheduled XNYS close (16:00 ET; 13:00 ET on early-close days)

definitions.downsideEvent: E_h = 1 if MDD_h <= -0.10 (a drawdown of 10% or more within the horizon, measured on ^SP500TR closes from the base); secondary threshold -0.20 for h>=63
definitions.forwardReturn: R_h = P[b+h]/P[b] - 1, b = base session index, P = ^SP500TR close
definitions.maxDrawdown: MDD_h = min_{k=0..h} (P[b+k]/max_{j=0..k} P[b+j] - 1); close-to-close, includes base; reported as a negative fraction
definitions.realizedVol: RV_h = sqrt(252) * sd(ln(P[b+k]/P[b+k-1]), k=1..h, ddof=1); defined for h>=5 only (h=1 omitted)
definitions.regimeTransition: T_h = 1 if the frozen PI regime band at the designated state h sessions later differs from the band at the state; U_h = 1 if it is higher. Computable only where the PI path is reconstructed (C1) or recorded (C2); reported per horizon as frequency with CI. Exploratory.

eventList.primaryForH4: ruleB onset10 dates; bear = onset20 present
eventList.ruleA: all-time-high drawdown episodes on ^GSPC: onset10 = first close >= 10% below running max; ends at a new running max
eventList.ruleB: rolling 252-session-high drawdown episodes on ^GSPC: onset10 = first close >= 10% below max of the last 252 closes; ends when drawdown recovers above -2%

outcomes.horizonNotes: Horizons count XNYS trading sessions after the base close, never calendar days. Horizons 126 and 252 are descriptive in set C1 (N_eff < 30 by construction).

missingData.earlyCloseDays: complete sessions with 13:00 ET close; completedAt 14:00 ET.
missingData.incompleteTradingDay: a bar whose completedAt is after the time of use is treated as non-existent for that use (never used as base, target or input).
missingData.marketHolidaysAndUnscheduledClosures: not sessions (e.g. 2012-10-29/30, 2018-12-05, 2025-01-09); no state, no bar, horizons skip them.
missingData.missingBaseOrTargetBar: outcome is DEFERRED; it is never shifted to an adjacent bar. Re-fetch daily for 10 sessions; then status MISSING_BAR with reason; excluded and counted.
missingData.notYetMatured: PENDING; excluded from that horizon only.

sets.contamination: Engine was designed in 2026 with knowledge of this period; diagnostic, cannot alone support PASS.
sets.expectedN: 738 XNYS sessions (counted from the ^GSPC bar calendar, no FAULTLINE data); N_eff = N/h: 1d 738, 5d 147, 10d 73, 21d 35, 63d 11, 126d 5, 252d 2
sets.label: RETROSPECTIVE_RECONSTRUCTION (not a validated backtest)
sets.name: Faithful-input historical reconstruction
sets.rule: All 8 engine inputs from ALFRED vintages; no proxies, no fallback constants (state INPUT_UNAVAILABLE if any series missing). Engine code executed unchanged at 1cfa129 with an injected fetch layer replaying vintages in engine.ts FRED_SERIES order/limits.

sets.checkpoints: Descriptive interim reports allowed monthly without verdict. Verdict computed once, when >= 630 QLS states have matured 21d outcomes (approx. 2029); earlier verdict only MIXED-INCONCLUSIVE by rule.
sets.label: FORWARD_LIVE
sets.name: Live forward record (only untouched holdout)
sets.rule: QLS vf-qls-v1: scheduled 18:00 UTC cron, manifest generatedAt in [18:00,18:30) UTC, NYSE trading day, earliest qualifying row per ET market date, hash integrity. Primary sensitivity: only states with runProvenance.codeVersion = 1cfa129 (first possible: 2026-10-05).

sets.label: EXPLORATORY_PROXY (separate test id FL-HV-2026-10-04-002 must be pre-registered before it is run)
sets.name: Proxy reconstruction 2001-01-02 .. 2023-10-03
sets.rule: HY OAS proxy = OLS map of BAA10Y onto HY OAS fitted on 2023-10-03..2026-09-14 input data only; SOFR proxy = DFF before 2018-04-02; DGS10/DGS2 before 2005-06-28 = earliest-vintage values (label EARLIEST_VINTAGE_BACKFILL). No verdict weight in this test id.

status: PROPOSED - awaiting James approval; no historical result has been computed

timing.engineQuirksReproduced: latestValid with limit 2 returns fallback if both obs are "." (holiday); CPI/PPI YoY use obs[12] positionally; HY conversion x100 if <=20. In C1 a fallback is not allowed (INPUT_UNAVAILABLE); sensitivity FALLBACK_AS_PRODUCTION uses engine constants.

inputAvailability.market: latest completed close = previous session (and early-close same session only if completedAt < evalTime)
inputAvailability.primary: FRED/ALFRED value usable at D iff its vintage realtime_start < D (calendar), i.e. next day after release; conservative because the state precedes most afternoon FRED updates
inputAvailability.sensitivity: SAME_DAY_RELEASE: for HY OAS, SOFR and VIXCLS (morning publication) allow realtime_start = D

timing.observedAtTreatment: Prod observedAt is null; historical observedAt := evalTime of the designated state; per-input availability recorded as the ALFRED realtime_start of the vintage used. Never back-filled into prod.
timing.stateGeneration: One designated state per XNYS session D at 18:00:00 UTC (= 14:00 ET under EDT, 13:00 ET under EST; mirrors prod cron 0 18 * * *). No state on non-sessions. Reruns never replace a designated state.
timing.stateRecord: Each evaluated state stores stateId, runId, evalTime (UTC ISO), engine SHA, formulaHash, methodology hash, input snapshot id (sha256 of the vintage set), per-series realtime_start, and set label (C1/C2/E1).
timing.unavailableHistoricalInputs: UNAVAILABLE for that period; no proxy without separate documentation and sensitivity label; counted and reported.

verdict.FAIL: In any set with N_eff >= 30: (a) PM1 or PM2 significant in the wrong direction; or (b) the 95% CI for rho(PI, MDD_21) lies entirely above -0.10 (effect economically negligible) and FAULTLINE does not beat B12 at p < 0.05; or (c) delta-rho vs B11 or vs the best single benchmark has a 95% CI entirely below 0.
verdict.MIXED-INCONCLUSIVE: Anything else, including: N_eff < 30; H2 untestable (fewer than 2 occupied bands); significant but below economic thresholds; passes C1 but not C2; beats null but not benchmarks.
verdict.PASS: In set C2 (live forward holdout) at its final checkpoint AND in set C1: PM1, PM2, PM3 significant after Holm in the predicted direction, each meeting its economic threshold, and PM4 delta-rho >= 0.05 against both B11 and the best single benchmark with 95% CI excluding 0, and FAULTLINE beats the B12 null at p < 0.05. N_eff >= 30 in each set. C1 alone can never yield PASS (in-sample-contaminated).

economicThresholds.mdd21GapHighVsLow: mean MDD_21 of states with PI>=45 at least 2.0 pp deeper than states with PI<45

verdict.reporting: Every verdict lists N, N_eff, events, point estimates, CIs, raw and Holm p-values for PM1-PM4 per set.
